# OpenDock

> OpenDock is a free, open-source (MIT) dock and taskbar replacement for Windows 10 and 11. It shows pinned apps and open windows with live previews, a Start launcher, and widgets such as clock, media, weather, calendar and focus timer. Local automation rules can act on events. It has no account, no backend and no telemetry, and it always restores the Windows taskbar on quit, crash or uninstall.

## Pages

- [Home](https://opendock.pages.dev/): What OpenDock does and how it protects your privacy

- [Documentation](https://opendock.pages.dev/docs/): Installation, user guide, security model and contributor guides
- [Roadmap](https://opendock.pages.dev/roadmap/): 1.0 for Windows, the widget SDK, Linux and macOS
- [Changelog](https://opendock.pages.dev/changelog/): Release history
- [Privacy](https://opendock.pages.dev/privacy/): How the app and website handle data
